title: App entry
description: Frontmatter of a file in content/app/. The body of the file is prose and is not validated here.

slug.description: Must match the filename. Becomes the URL at /app/<slug>/.

package.description: Android application ID, where there is one.

service_type.description: Must match a slug in data/service-types.yaml. validate.py asserts the two lists are identical.

countries.description: Where the app is relevant. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, from data/countries.yaml.

global.description: App is relevant everywhere. Use instead of countries.

requires_play_services.description: Whether the app needs Play Services to function.

alternatives.description: Other ways to do this app's job when the app cannot. Applies to the app as a whole rather than to one report, because what an alternative covers does not change with the OS build. A bank's website exists whether or not the app installs.

reports.description: Newest first. validate.py fails the build if the order is wrong. An empty list is valid and means nobody has reported testing this app yet.

kind.description: Must match a value in data/statuses.yaml under alternative_kind.

label.description: Short name, shown as the link or heading.

covers.description: Whether the alternative replaces the app completely. Partial is the common case and the honest one: a bank website restores account access but not UPI.

detail.description: What it does, in plain language.

limitation.description: What the alternative does not do. Required when covers is partial.

report.description: Fields a genuine contribution must supply are required only for non-imported tiers. An imported report is a summary of somebody else's public post, and forcing it to name a device, a profile and a build the original author never stated would mean inventing them. The if/then below enforces the split: imported reports must cite a source, everything else must be first-hand.

date.description: The day the test was run. Not the day the file was edited. For an imported report, the date of the source.

build.description: GrapheneOS build, YYYYMMDDNN. Null where the source did not state one. A guessed build is worse than no build.

device.description: Slug from data/devices.yaml, or null if the source did not say.

profile.description: Which user profile the app was tested in.

country.description: Where the app was used, not where the reporter lives.

carrier.description: Only set when the failure is carrier-related.

play.description: How Play Services were provided, if at all.

blocked_reason.description: Only set this if the reporter actually knows why. A wrong reason sends the next person down a path that cannot work.

workaround.description: Steps, or the name of an alternative app. Required when fixability is possible-with-steps or possible-via-workaround.

reporter.description: The person who ran the test. Required for every tier except imported, where the report was not filed by anyone here.

source.description: Public source this report was imported from. Required for tier imported. A contributor's own report must never carry this: if it does, it is second-hand and should be rejected.
